description:
RNTOR connects ChatGPT to your flexible workspace management platform, giving authorized teams instant access to operational data for reporting, member support, billing review, and everyday decision-making.

Ask questions in natural language and get answers from the RNTOR data you’re permitted to access—without switching dashboards or building reports manually.

Key capabilities:
• Review networks, locations, resources, and bookings.
• Look up customers and companies, including membership and account status.
• Explore plans, subscriptions, invoices, contracts, and contract templates.
• Review shop categories, products, orders, benefits, and benefit applications.
• Access published member guides and operational information.

RNTOR in ChatGPT is read-only. It can retrieve and analyze authorized data, but it cannot create, update, delete, approve, send, charge, sign, or trigger workflows. Access follows RNTOR user permissions, network isolation, and live/test boundaries.

defaultPrompt: Show unpaid invoices and subscriptions renewing in the next 30 days, grouped by location.
Summarize this month’s bookings by location and status, and highlight the busiest resources.
Give me today’s operations overview across all locations: bookings, shop orders, and active benefits.
